content: Hi! How can I help you with your travel photos or videos today?
Hey! I tried opening the album you sent, but it says I need permission. Can you resend it?

Oh, sorry about that! I'll update the link so it's view-only for everyone, privacy first. Here's the new album link: <updated_album_link>. Please try clicking it and let me know if you can browse through this time.
That worked! The captions are such a sweet touch, love the one under the mountain sunrise shot.

I'm glad you noticed! That sunrise was one of my favorites. If you'd like any of the originals, just click the download button under any photo, or use the 'Download All' option up top to grab a ZIP of the full set.
Downloading now! By the way, the videos seem a bit choppy on my phone, are they compressed?

Some platforms reduce quality for previews. For smoother playback, download the original video files, those are in MP4 format for easy viewing. You can find them in the 'Videos' subfolder if you scroll down or use the filter.
Found them! Is it okay if I upload a few clips from my GoPro, or will it mess with the album order?
Absolutely, please upload! Just use the 'Add files' button. I'll label your clips as 'Guest Footage' for clarity, so everything stays organized.
Uploading now. Also, should I convert my .MOV files to MP4 before sharing?
MP4 works best for most viewers, but feel free to upload .MOV files too, I can convert and re-upload them if needed. Once you're done, browse the album again to make sure everything looks right.
Thanks! One more thing, can I share the album with family, or should I send just the view-only link?

For privacy, I recommend sharing the view-only link so everyone can enjoy the memories but can't edit or delete files. Let me know if you'd like a highlights reel too, I can prep one for easy downloading.
A highlights reel sounds great! Thanks for organizing all this, it makes reliving the trip so much easier.
My pleasure! I'll upload the highlights video soon and message you once it's ready. Meanwhile, feel free to download or browse the album as much as you like. Let me know if you need anything else!
